description: 005930.KS daily adjusted-close price series (KRW); per-stock slice of the prices blob.

body.how_to_read: Filter primary_id == '005930.KS' in data/blobs/prices.csv; 'value' is the adjusted close in KRW, one row per trading day (TS).

methodology.summary: Per-stock slice of the prices pipeline output (prices.csv); 6605 daily rows 2000-01-04..2026-06-05. Mechanically templated over the blob's distinct tickers (one card per stock). Confidence 0.9 (realized market prices).
